author_or_account: National Bureau of Economic Research; Jessica Leight; Cevat Giray Aksoy
title: Remote Workers Boost Productivity and Retention with In-Office Days
discussion_signal: The NBER relay reports that a coordinated monthly office day improved productivity, communication, and retention for fully remote workers. Discussion includes practical support for deliberate in-person connection and counter-signals that the result may not generalize beyond one customer-service firm or justify a broad office mandate.
linked_research_question: When does coordinated physical proximity improve remote-work coordination enough to offset the time and autonomy costs imposed on workers?
limits: LinkedIn discussion is a selected audience
Comments challenge external validity and the strength of the general claim
The experiment concerns a specific firm and worker population
